articles.title: Live updates: Crypto gives up more ground as AI selloff picks up steam
articles.snippet: A Friday surge in oil prices is hitting already-shaky equity markets, sending the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

articles.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
articles.snippet: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.

articles.title: At the White House, crypto policy vacancy looms large
articles.snippet: The departure of President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, leaves the digital assets office vacant and its policy aims uncertain.

articles.title: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
articles.snippet: The scheme allegedly stole tens of millions through Russian-language Facebook ads and fake advisers, then went after victims again with fake recovery offers.

articles.title: Hyperliquid founder wants U.S. oversight of trading platforms, not his blockchain
articles.snippet: Jeff Yan told Bloomberg that U.S. regulatory oversight should apply to the firms using the blockchain, not to the underlying network itself.
